papers.title: Field performance review at Rubiales: lessons for heavy oil development (1)
papers.abstract: This paper reports a field performance review at the Rubiales field, CO. The reservoir has oil viscosity of 1200 cP and crude of 12.5 degrees API. Further data include permeability of 2500 md, an average porosity of 30%, net pay of 40 m. The authors compare the outcome with offset wells and discuss operational implications for future development planning in similar clastic reservoirs, including surveillance requirements and cost drivers. Results are discussed for the water-drive mechanism.
